settings.editor: At Petitt Heating & Cooling, we keep the air flowing and the water moving. Our licensed HVAC technicians and plumbers proudly serve homeowners across Sumner, Robertson, and Davidson Counties with honest work and dependable results.

icon_list.text: Precision Cooling & AC Repair: Emergency AC repairs, seasonal tune-ups, and energy-efficient installations designed to lower bills and improve comfort.
Reliable Heating & Furnace Care: Furnace repair, heat pump maintenance, and gas log servicing to keep your home warm all winter.
Expert Plumbing Services: From water heater replacements to emergency leak repairs, our plumbers handle your toughest issues fast.
Total Indoor Air Quality: Improve your home’s air with UV lights, air scrubbers, dehumidifiers, and crawlspace encapsulation.

settings.title: Your Local, Family-Owned Home Comfort Team

settings.editor:
Founded in 2010 by Mike and Trina Petitt, our company was built on a simple mission: providing our neighbors with honest service that never cuts corners.

 

With over 30 years of industry experience, we are a family-owned team dedicated to excellence and giving back to the Middle Tennessee community we call home.

At Petitt Heating & Cooling, we stand behind our word and our work. This is our personal
commitment to your home’s comfort and your family’s well-being.

icon_list.text: The $500 Installation Guarantee: We respect your time. If our team does not show up on your scheduled installation day, we will pay you $500.
10-Year Peace of Mind: We don’t just install it—we stand by it. New installations include a full 10-year parts and labor warranty to protect your investment
12-Hour Priority Response We don't leave our neighbors in the heat or the cold. If your primary system fails, we guarantee a technician will be at your door within 12 hours.
Certified Expertise: Our team holds TN Mechanical Licenses and EPA Certifications with over 50 years of combined industry experience.

settings.editor: Comfort shouldn’t wait—and it shouldn’t break your budget. We offer flexible financing options and low monthly payments so you can handle repairs or replacements without stress.
